subject.title: fix(auto-reply): skip transient preflight compaction failures instead of terminating Composer

question: Should this external PR wait for redacted real WebChat/Control UI proof, or should a maintainer explicitly override the proof gate based on source and test evidence?
rationale: ClawSweeper can verify the source path and tests, but cannot fabricate or waive the required after-fix real behavior proof for an external PR.

options.title: Require Real Behavior Proof
options.body: Keep the narrowed patch open until the contributor or maintainer posts redacted WebChat/Control UI, live-output, terminal, or log proof of the transient failure path.

options.title: Override Proof Gate
options.body: A maintainer may explicitly accept source/test-only evidence and own the remaining UI recovery risk before merge.

options.title: Pause For UI Recovery Direction
options.body: If fail-open preflight behavior is not the desired product policy, pause this branch and pursue a gateway/UI lifecycle recovery fix instead.

recommendation.title: Require Real Behavior Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the narrowed patch open until the contributor or maintainer posts redacted WebChat/Control UI, live-output, terminal, or log proof of the transient failure path.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is centered on compaction/context failure policy, which CONTRIBUTING.md assigns to jalehman and recent history shows in the same area.
